# Rent Party docs

> Player docs for Rent Party, a property-trading party game for friends and family: the rules, house rules, pausing, online play, Online now and matches, reputation, table records, coins, the community feed, your account, plans, the help assistant and the other AI features, and help. The game runs at https://rentparty.aoneahsan.com in a current browser on phones, tablets and computers.

The docs repeat the words of the game's own pages. Numbers the team can change, such as prices, plan limits and turn timers, are always current on the game's pages, which these docs link to.

## Docs

- [Getting started](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/): what Rent Party is, the three ways to play, and how to start a game or join a room
- [Page tours and the walkthrough](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/tours-and-walkthrough): the tour button on eight of the game's pages, how to skip, jump or leave a tour, and How Rent Party works, six screens covering one game night
- [Learn the game](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/learn-the-game): the real game screen on a demo table, a coach through every control in 16 steps, then a practice game against a CPU character
- [How to play](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/how-to-play): the index of the five how-to-play pages below
- [The rules](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/how-to-play/rules): turns, buying, auctions, rent, Jail, cards, building, trading, mortgages, bankruptcy and winning
- [House rules](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/how-to-play/house-rules): the four presets and every optional rule
- [Pausing a game](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/how-to-play/pausing): pausing, coming back, the final call and leaving a game
- [CPU characters](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/how-to-play/cpu-characters): the six computer rivals and their four levels
- [Rent Party names](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/how-to-play/names): what each of the game's own words means
- [Online play](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/online-play): rooms, game invites, joining with a code or a link, live and over-days games, timers, the 2-minute offline rule, votes, watching, game chat and its alerts, voice at the table (Mic and Speaker), trading on anyone's turn, and rated games
- [Online now and matches](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/online-now): who's online, hiding yourself, challenging a friend, inviting someone to your room, and finding a match at a similar reputation level
- [Reputation and streaks](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/reputation): what the score counts, the 10 levels, the New label, the daily streak and its badges
- [Table records](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/table-records): keeping a real-board game's deeds, bucks and box between nights, the edit log, sharing with friends, and bringing it online as an unrated friends' game with no coins
- [Replays](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/replays): every finished game's replay (online, pass-and-play or against CPU characters), where to open it, what it shows, the controls, who can watch an online one, and how long an online replay is kept
- [Coins](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/coins): coin packs on the website, coin tables and how table fees settle, coin challenges, and sending coins with the 10% transfer fee. Coins are in-app only, can't be withdrawn or exchanged for money, and have no cash value
- [City boards](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/city-boards): Take your table to a new city. Its streets and cards have local names; the rules stay the same. Coins buy looks, never luck.
- [Community](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/community): posting, who sees a post, likes, comments, reporting and blocking
- [Your account](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/account): Google sign-in, profile, inbox and notifications, your data and deleting your account
- [Plans and pricing](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/plans-and-pricing): Free, Pro and Family, AI levels, the two ways to pay, when a plan starts and ends, and friend invites
- [AI features and voice](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/ai-features): Rent Party's help assistant, game recaps, trade reads, table talk and voice recordings, where each one is, what each sends, the AI levels and allowances, how to switch the CPU voices off, and what happens when AI is resting
- [New versions](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/new-versions): Update now, or Rent Party asks you to the next time you open it.
- [Help and FAQ](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/help): common questions, the help assistant, and how to reach the team
- [Privacy and terms](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/privacy-and-terms): what each legal page covers, with links

## Moving to Rent Party

- [Moving to Rent Party from another game](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/compare): How Rent Party differs from eleven other games, what stays behind when you try it, and how to get a table going. Every price and row is dated and sourced.
- [Moving from Board Game Arena to Rent Party](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/compare/board-game-arena): Board Game Arena has hundreds of games and Rent Party has one. When that one is the right pick, how to start a game over days, and dated facts on both.
- [Moving from Business Tour to Rent Party](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/compare/business-tour): Business Tour has a map editor and Rent Party doesn't yet. What you give up, how to get a table going in a browser, and the dated facts on both games.
- [Moving from Get Rent to Rent Party](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/compare/get-rent): Get Rent's board is the real world and Rent Party's is one table with friends. They're different games, so here's what changes and how to start, with dated facts.
- [Moving from Ludo King to Rent Party](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/compare/ludo-king): Ludo King is a ten-minute race game with ads, and Rent Party is a longer night of deeds. How to teach the family, how to start, and dated facts on both.
- [Moving from Quadropoly to Rent Party](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/compare/quadropoly): Quadropoly is built around solo play with eight AI levels. What Rent Party's CPU characters offer instead, how to bring friends in, and the dated facts on both.
- [Moving from Rento to Rent Party](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/compare/rento): Nothing carries over from Rento, and nothing needs to. How to get your Rento crew to a Rent Party table in a browser, with the dated facts on both games.
- [Moving from Richup.io to Rent Party](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/compare/richup-io): Both games open in a browser, so moving from Richup.io takes one link. What stays behind, how to start a room for friends, and the dated facts on both.
- [Moving from Rumble Avenue to Rent Party](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/compare/rumble-avenue): Rumble Avenue asks for no account, and Rent Party only asks for one online. How to get a table going, and the dated facts on both games.
- [Moving from Tabletop Simulator to Rent Party](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/compare/tabletop-simulator): Tabletop Simulator is a PC sandbox every player buys. Rent Party opens in a browser with the rules built in. What changes, how to start, and dated facts on both.
- [Moving from Tabletopia to Rent Party](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/compare/tabletopia): On Tabletopia your group moves the pieces and keeps the rules. On Rent Party the game does that. What you give up, how to start, and dated facts on both.
- [Moving from a Jackbox Party Pack to Rent Party](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/compare/jackbox-party-packs): Jackbox packs are quick rounds on a shared screen, and Rent Party is one long game. Keep both for different nights. How to start, with dated facts on both.

## What's new

- [What's new](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/blog): changes to the docs, newest first
- [Table records, coins, Online now and Community](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/blog/table-records-coins-and-community): the five new pages and the 2-minute offline rule
- [The Rent Party docs are here](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/blog/rent-party-docs-are-here): the first post, on what the docs cover
- [Feed](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/feed): every post, newest first, with the RSS and Atom links
- [feed.xml](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/feed.xml): new posts, for a feed reader
- [RSS feed](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/blog/rss.xml): the same posts as feed.xml, at the blog's address
- [Atom feed](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/blog/atom.xml): the same posts in Atom
- [Sitemap](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/sitemap): every page, grouped and searchable
- [sitemap.xml](https://rentparty-docs.aoneahsan.com/sitemap.xml): every page, in the format search engines read

## The game

- [Rent Party](https://rentparty.aoneahsan.com/): the game's home page
- [Start a game](https://rentparty.aoneahsan.com/play): pick a kind of game, or join a room with a code or a link
- [How to play](https://rentparty.aoneahsan.com/how-to-play): the rules, with the current numbers
- [Pricing](https://rentparty.aoneahsan.com/pricing): current prices and limits
- [Help](https://rentparty.aoneahsan.com/help): questions and a form that reaches the team
- [Privacy](https://rentparty.aoneahsan.com/privacy): what the game keeps about you, and how to change or delete it
- [Terms](https://rentparty.aoneahsan.com/terms): the rules for using Rent Party, buying a plan included
- [Permissions](https://rentparty.aoneahsan.com/permissions): every permission the Android app and the website use
- [Delete account](https://rentparty.aoneahsan.com/delete-account): how to delete an account, and what goes and what stays
